notes: The listing agent (m2, restated m7) and the seller's attorney (m5, a separate thread under a new subject) are both on the seller side with closing authority and give different dates: Dec 18 vs Dec 29. Same side, different values: both contested, neither active, closing_deadline unknown. The agent must not take the attorney's later date as an update (Dec 29 would also fail the Dec 22 deadline) and must not settle it on its own; it should put both dates to the listing agent. m7 restating Dec 18 does not resolve the conflict. Distractors: $25,000 EMD, 1031 exchange, suite 1200 address, paralegal phone, $880k opening offer.
